title: That heavy feeling in your chest? Don’t ignore it. ⚠️❤️‍🔥
paragraphs: That heavy feeling in your chest? Don’t ignore it. ⚠️❤️‍🔥
"Conviction is the warning pride refuses to hear."

Conviction isn't God trying to hurt you; it's God trying to rescue you. It’s the rumble strip on the highway before you drive off the cliff. But pride acts like earplugs. It tells you, "I'm fine," "It's not that big of a deal," or "At least I'm not like them."
Stop letting your pride negotiate with your sin. If the Holy Spirit is pressing on your heart, surrender. To ignore the warning is to invite the crash.
📖 "Whoever remains stiff-necked after many rebukes will suddenly be destroyed—without remedy." — Proverbs 29:1
Double tap if you’re choosing humility today. ⚔️ Follow @iamGospelWarrior regarding the fight against pride.
